diagnosis.scope: Bounded diagnostic instruction replay of unchanged Lotus2 archive using the preceding Major Motion ROM and native Kickstart, identical frozen engine/CPU. No interventions. Debug Peek mirrors 256KiB native ROM. An earlier native trace failed in observer ROM indexing and is excluded. Full runner native-control replays are independent.
diagnosis.cause: The packed stream is identical through stage one. Copying it through upper Chip RAM overlaps the bootstrap SSP: a running VBlank saves 6 exception bytes plus 60 register bytes at $77F2A-$77F6B. The following unpacking passes are corrupted. Kickstart has SSP in A501 RAM.

visualReview.drivingParagraph: At field 13,000, both positive runs show 61 MPH and 47,890 points; each idle control shows 9 MPH and zero points. The sampled title, menu, countdown and early driving images agree with the native control. The race timer expires and both runs return to the title by field 16,000; stage completion is not claimed. At the later shared field 14,000, both show 9 MPH and timer 11, with slightly different road position and scores of 77,930 under Kickstart and 77,940 under CopperStart. Cross-ROM trajectory identity is not required.
visualReview.regressionParagraph: The same corrected image also completes the retained 46,000-field Overdrive, 40,000-field Arte, 18,000-field Major Motion and 24,000-field Lemmings scenarios. Overdrive retains qualifying movement and steering. Arte reaches its credits and returns to the intro, preserving the large-allocation workload. Major Motion reaches opening play and a high-score result; its new trajectory differs from the preceding ROM. Lemmings rescues 100% in level one. These are bounded replay regressions, not full-game or physical timing qualifications.

regressions.observation: Qualifying remains active; player acceleration/steering change car and road position. Later captures show the car off the track after scripted steering. No race/lap-completion claim.
Multiple coherent effects, scrolling credits at 24,000, textured scene at 32,000 and return to the intro graphic by 40,000. The large-memory demo continues with the new 8,192-byte SSP allocation.

Title at 8,000 and 10,000, then coherent road, cars and HUD, opening movement and score progression. High-score screen by 18,000 with 923 points. The trajectory differs from the preceding ROM; raw-fingerprint identity is not claimed.
Active level-one play at 16,000; result screens at 22,000 and 24,000 report 100% rescued and the level-two access code.
